weeks.sub_strand: Plant vs Animal Cells & Simplifying Algebraic Terms
learning_outcomes: Compare specialized plant and animal cells under magnification

lessons.subject: Cambridge Science (0893)
lessons.topic: Cell Biology: Onion Epidermal Wet Mount Investigation
lessons.parent_script: Every living organism is built from microscopic cells. Today we prepare a real plant slide to observe cell walls and nuclei.
lessons.learning_objective: Prepare a wet mount slide of onion epidermis and distinguish cell wall, cytoplasm, and nucleus.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Peel thin transparent onion membrane.
2. Add one drop of iodine stain.
3. View at 100x and 400x magnification and sketch labeled diagram.

lessons.subject: Cambridge Mathematics (0862)
lessons.parent_script: Variables allow us to represent generalized patterns. Let us use the distributive property to expand expressions.
lessons.learning_objective: Expand and simplify expressions of the form a(bx + c) + d(ex + f).
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Geometric area model of expansion.
2. Work through 8 stepped algebraic problems.
3. Check solutions with substitution.

lessons.subject: Global Perspectives (0876)
lessons.topic: Analyzing Global Water Scarcity & Evidence Evaluation
lessons.parent_script: Global Perspectives trains you to evaluate sources, detect bias, and propose sustainable local solutions.
lessons.learning_objective: Synthesize data from two international NGO reports and evaluate perspectives on water conservation.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Annotate key statistical claims.
2. Compare rural vs urban access disparities in East Africa.
3. Write a 200-word critical perspective brief.
